audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Cassiopeia Level 1 and 2+ items, and the full-layer tldr called it 'A DPS check he fails'. This is a 41.27% lane over 63 games — the worst in the champion's top-lane pool — and the entry's own text says 'Urgot owns levels 1-3' and 'This is where I lose outright'.
audit.why: Lane difficulty is a key point, and a tldr promising a DPS check he fails is the single most misleading string on a page for a lane Cassiopeia loses by nine points.
audit.corrected: Urgot / Urgot / Skill / Urgot / Skill / Urgot / Urgot in both layers, with Level 3 and Level 6 the two contested stages; tldr and winCon rewritten to match.
sources: the entry's own early and late text

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in both layers and the number is never given anywhere; Fear Beyond Death is unnumbered too.
audit.why: Power spikes is a key point. Disdain at 16s is one of the longest engage cooldowns in the top lane and it is the entire punish window in a lane where you get exactly one — 'step up only on its downtime' is meaningless without it.
audit.corrected: Disdain quoted as 16s at rank 1 falling to 14s, Fear Beyond Death as 100s at rank 1, in the level-6 spike, mid and the cooldown text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain shields Urgot as he charges, and no string in either layer mentions it. The entry builds the whole matchup around punishing his flip with Petrifying Gaze without noting that the flip arrives with a shield already up.
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point. You get one commit per 16 seconds in this lane; spending it into an unbroken shield is how the one window you had turns into the death that ends the lane.
audit.corrected: Disdain's self-shield stated in the level-6 spike, in mid, in wants.foe[1] and in the cooldown text, with 'force the shield out before you spend the stun' as the sequencing.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json (E Disdain, shield flag; 'charges in a direction, shielding himself')

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid, late and whys[2] are written in the first person — 'This is where I lose outright', 'my Miasma (W) grounding', 'he flips me dead'.
audit.why: The rest of champ-data/content/cassiopeia.js addresses the player in the second person.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in second person in every string I touched.
sources: voice used across the rest of champ-data/content/cassiopeia.js

audit.why: Riot's name is Twin Fang. The packet also flagged 'Save Petrifying Gaze', 'Bait Petrifying Gaze' and 'My Miasma' as suspect names — the first two are false positives and the third is the voice problem above, not a naming error.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he keeps me honest with Purge leg pressure whenever I overstep, but level 6 is my one real window. The plan is reactive: bait his Disdain (E) flip first — when he commits it to drag me onto his legs, answer with Petrifying Gaze (R) while he's facing me. The stun cancels his Purge cadence and I chain Twin Fang on my Q/W poison while he can't fire back. If I throw R out early on poke or whiff the facing angle, his E is up, he flips me point-blank, and his percent-HP legs delete my no-resist body. Outside that exact R-on-the-flip catch, his sustained DPS out-trades my ramp.

Throw R out early on poke or whiff the facing angle and his E is back up, he flips you point-blank, and his legs delete your no-resist body in seconds.

edits.before: This is where I lose outright. Urgot stacks armor and health while I build glass with no resistances, so his percent-HP Purge legs out-trade my single-target poison the longer it runs. Fear Beyond Death (R) latches onto me and, the instant I drop under its missing-HP threshold, executes me — and the fear stops me kiting out on my passive move speed, which my whole kit depends on (an uninterrupted target and free movement, both of which his R strips). My range edge means nothing once he has Disdain (E) to close the gap. Convert any level-6 R-catch into a closed game; if it runs long, stop dueling and use my poke to zone for the team instead of feeding his execute.

notes: TWO CLAIMS LEFT ALONE BECAUSE THE KITS CANNOT SETTLE THEM. (1) This entry says nine times that Purge deals percent-max-HP damage. champ-data/_kits/urgot.json carries no percentHealth flag anywhere in his kit and Riot's text for Echoing Flames and Purge says only 'physical damage' — so I could not verify it. I did not delete the claim, but I also did not repeat it in the strings I rewrote, which now say his legs shred a no-resist body without asserting the scaling. (2) The entry states Miasma's grounding cannot disable Disdain because he is dashless. Riot describes Disdain as 'charges in a direction', which reads as a movement ability, but the kit's derived flags give E projectile/hardCC/shield and no dash — while giving Corrosive Charge (Q) a dash flag it plainly should not have, so the flags on this champion are unreliable in both directions. Left as written; see questionsForUser.
